chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Hammad from Abu Hamzah said:
I asked him about a man who trimmed his fingernails except for one finger. He said, 'He forgot.' I said, 'Yes.' He said, 'There is no harm.'
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a pilgrim forgets to trim a fingernail while in Ihram?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies that forgetting to trim a single nail during Ihram incurs no penalty, highlighting the Shia principle that minor omissions due to forgetfulness do not trigger the *kaffarah* (expiation). This ruling underscores the distinction between intentional violation and unintentional oversight in the jurisprudence of Hajj rituals.
